versions.changelog: Add human-friendly tutorial section to SKILL.md for ClawHub display. README and SKILL.md now consistent.
Rewrite README with human-user tutorial front-and-center. Add agent contextual evaluation guide.

Remove threshold-based upgrade advice. Add agent contextual evaluation guide - agent should combine script output with user's actual config (channels/plugins/runtime/Node version/deployment) to judge which bugs matter.
Add built-in quality assessment: actionable/duplicate/vague detection markers, zero LLM dependency, upgrade recommendation based on actionable count

Initial release of openclaw-version-bug-hunter.

- Enables querying GitHub for bug/issue reports for specific OpenClaw versions.
- Categorizes issues into Critical, Regression, General Bugs with statistics and PR status.
- Provides command-line script for version-based bug hunting and upgrade risk assessment.
- Includes guides for dependency checks, API limits, advanced searches, and troubleshooting.
- Supports exporting reports and comparing different OpenClaw versions.
